Title: Public Preview: App Service End-to-end (E2E) Encryption for Linux Multi-tenant Resources

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce that the end-to-end (E2E) TLS encryption for intra-cluster traffic between App Service front-ends and workers, which used to be only available for App Service Environment (ASE) resources, is now available in Preview for multi-tenant Linux App Service!

Learn more.
